_about: The logging lesson 16.1 asks for. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: hardened
_data_access_aiplatform: DATA_READ and DATA_WRITE for aiplatform.googleapis.com, set at the organization.
_data_access_storage: DATA_WRITE for storage.googleapis.com in the project that holds the RAG source bucket.
_request_response_models: Request-response logging at sampling rate 1 into a CMEK dataset for the two Gemini models. Claude on Agent Platform needs a separate REST call that nobody made yet: its calls are in Data Access logs only. The backend sets labels end_user and session on every request.
_model_armor_logging: logSanitizeOperations on the template, routed by a sink to a log bucket only the incident team can read.
_scc_tier: Security Command Center Premium, activated at the organization, pay-as-you-go: Event Threat Detection's AI rules run (New Geography for AI Service isn't available for project-level activations). Agent Platform Threat Detection doesn't cover the Helpdesk agent: it isn't available when Agent Gateway is enabled for an agent.
_app_log_identity: Request ID, signed-in user, session ID, agent session ID, the model's responseId and token counts per request.
